name: Styrene
aliases: Cinnamene, Cinnamenol, Cinnaminol, Cinnamol, ethenyl benzene, Ethenyl-Benzene, ethenylbenzene, Ethenylbenzene, 9CI
summary: Styrene is an organic compound with the chemical formula C6H5CH=CH2. Its structure consists of a vinyl group as substituent on benzene. Styrene is a colorless, oily liquid, although aged samples can appear yellowish. The compound evaporates easily and has a sweet smell, although high concentrations have a less pleasant odor.
